findings.description: A launch evaluates `overlapsWorthANotice(db, conflicts)` twice: once for the kickoff, and again in `introduceToPeers` after the kickoff is delivered. A fix round does the same, in `recompileSessionProfile` and then `recordOverlaps`. If a peer is running at compile time but idle at notice time, it is listed in `## Peers` but never introduced, and the kickoff then has the newcomer message it, waking the idle window decision 104 exists to spare. Decision 104's Ceilings text ("A session that turns running a moment later is neither listed nor told", docs/09-decisions.md ~L5740) is wrong: such a session is told. Compute the list once and pass it to both, or correct the Ceilings sentence. `land.service.ts` also expresses the same running-only rule in a different shape (`listSessions(db, ['running'])`).

An open-PR session that is awaiting review or blocked no longer gets the main-landed notice's `git merge` wording. It now takes the land at its next gate through fresh-base's `git rebase` and a `--force-with-lease` push, which rewrites the PR history that decision 99's merge wording protects. On a conflict, the rejection also tells the worker to rebase. Decision 104 says fresh-base "takes it in mechanically" without naming this trade-off; state it, at least as a Ceiling.

`filesWorthANotice` is exported but has a single caller (`overlapsWorthANotice`), and `APPEND_ONLY_FILES` is a one-element Set. AGENTS.md's "no abstraction until third use" suggests inlining the filter and dropping the export.

The land notice deliberately skips the `APPEND_ONLY_FILES` exclusion, but that split exists only in prose (the land JSDoc and the `APPEND_ONLY_FILES` JSDoc). A file later added to `APPEND_ONLY_FILES` would silently diverge between introductions and land notices.

In the `overlapsWorthANotice` JSDoc, "a fix round's own introduction" is still ambiguous. Suggested wording: "…is reached when it next works: by the gate's fresh-base stage, or, after a fix round, by the introduction recordOverlaps sends." Its last two sentences also repeat the rationale already in decision 104 and the `APPEND_ONLY_FILES` JSDoc.
The `recompileSessionProfile` JSDoc edit left an orphaned short line, `(decision 90). The`, before the sentence continues on the next line. Re-wrap the paragraph.
